title: Thinking on caring and being invested
summary: Kahran and Divya try to take apart what makes someone actually care about a thing — a brand, a person, a practice — versus just being interested. They land on identity: most caring is identity-shaped (you run because you're a runner, you parent because you're a parent), so wanting to make a successful company without seeing yourself as that person stalls out. Side detours into OCD vs OCPD, AI image generation, and Divya's two-year journey to feel like a person who works out.
topics: what makes us care about things
becoming the kind of person who works out
OCD vs OCPD ego dystonic vs ego syntonic
wanting to have written vs being a writer
new year resolutions that don't stick
running a successful company as an identity

intents.display: to think about why we care about some things and not others
